CustomField.description: NOT a native Roll-Up Summary — CampaignMember is a standard object and can never sit on the detail side of a Master-Detail relationship, so its link back to this record (Coupon_Code__c) is a plain Lookup, which Roll-Up Summary fields cannot summarize across. Maintained instead by Apex: DiscountService increments this by 1 each time it inserts a CampaignMember redemption row for this code.
CustomField.label: Total Redemptions
